title: Fourth Wing
author: Rebecca Yarros
summary: Violet was raised for a quiet life of books and is instead pushed into a war college where cadets must bond with dragons or die trying. Every rival is a threat, and the most dangerous one is hard to stop thinking about.
readIf: You want constant danger, sharp banter and a rivalry that slowly turns into something else.
skipIf: You prefer low-stakes reads, or graphic violence and open-door scenes are not for you.

pairings.reason: Another fierce heroine pulled into a dangerous world, with a brooding love interest and plenty of romantic tension.
Same hunger to see a gifted outsider survive a harsh academy, with slower pacing and far less romance.
